text: I am a Ph.D. student in Economics at the IMT School for Advanced Studies Lucca and the University of Alicante (UA). My supervisors are Ennio Bilancini and Carlos Cueva. Besides, I am a member of the Behavioral, Experimental, and Evolutionary (BEE) research group.
html: I am a Ph.D. student in Economics at the IMT School for Advanced Studies Lucca and the University of Alicante (UA). My supervisors are Ennio Bilancini and Carlos Cueva. Besides, I am a member of the Behavioral, Experimental, and Evolutionary (BEE) research group.

text: My main research interests are Behavioral and Experimental Economics, (Evolutionary) Game Theory, and Neuroeconomics. I am currently working on the topics of dishonesty, punishment, social norms, and strategic sophistication. In particular, I analyze the determinants of deception by creating methods to discriminate between false and true information and study the drivers of dishonesty and sanctions for communication. Besides, I study the evolution of conventions (i.e., long-run equilibria) in uncertain environments.
